questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 4। Electrostatic equilibrium conductor interior E=0, potential uniform and equal surface। centre potential (4) V, field zero মানে potential zero নয়।

questions.question_bn: Closed surface মোট electric flux 9/ε₀। enclosed charge কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 9। Gauss law ΦE=Qenclosed/ε₀⇒Qenclosed=(9)। surface-এর বাইরের charges net flux-এ অবদান zero।
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question_bn: Charge+2Cpotential 12 V→17Vquasistaticallymoved। external work কত J?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 5। ElectricpotentialenergychangeΔU=qΔV=2nJ। quasistaticexternaleffortpositive; electricfieldworknegativeofthis।
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question_bn: Chargedcapacitor Cvoltage 10 V connectsparallelidenticalunchargedC,batteryabsent। final total energy/initial energy কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 10। ChargeconservationQ=Cn,final Ceq2C,Vfinal=(10)/2。 Ufinal=½·2C((10)/2)²=¼Cn²;Uinitial½Cn²⇒ratio½।
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question_bn: Dipole pE=10 J। parallel থেকে 60° rotate করতে external quasistatic work কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 5। Dipole U=−p Ecosθ। ΔU=−pE/2−(−pE)=pE/2=(5); no kinetic change।

questions.question_bn: Capacitors 11 μF ও 22 μF series, total 6 V। small capacitor voltage কত?
